summary: Reviewed w235's commits ed25c279 and ab71c3fc, which match the implementer's result. Nothing under features/ changed and no test was removed or weakened; the only edit to an existing step (the_upstream_runs) is an added branch the plan lists. work delegate meets r65-r68, r70 and r71: it writes or inserts a JSON-quoted delegation field, commits through _change, refuses an empty delegation and a delivered, refused or withdrawn request, and does no turn check. r72 is carried by a UserPromptSubmit hook (migrate prompting) and shown with a session double; whether a live session obeys it cannot be verified. tools check: ruff errors only in files outside these commits, vulture clean. tools size: nothing over 300. Two Minor findings, both drop: the hook never reads its stdin, and its text goes out on every prompt.
